overview: Holotype AM F66763 is a fragment of right dentary with three molars from the Early Cretaceous Griman Creek Formation at Lightning Ridge, Australia. Comparison with monotreme and tribosphenic tooth patterns supports its identification as Steropodon galmani, while the 110–100 Ma interval remains a broad formation-level envelope rather than a direct specimen date or the full range of monotremes.
overviewZh: 正模 AM F66763 是一块带三枚臼齿的右侧齿骨碎片，出自澳大利亚 Lightning Ridge 的早白垩世 Griman Creek 组。与单孔类和三尖型牙齿模式的比较支持将其鉴定为 Steropodon galmani；110–100 Ma 仍是宽泛的组级年代包络，不是标本直接定年或单孔类的完整延限。

ecology.diet: Molar form permits a limited feeding inference; no food is preserved.
ecology.habitat: The jaw comes from Griman Creek deposits; its habitual habitat is not established.
ecology.locomotion: Movement is not preserved by the jaw.
ecology.bodySize: Whole-body size cannot be measured from this jaw alone.
ecology.guild: The teeth allow only a limited feeding inference; a broader ecological role is unresolved.
ecology.dietZh: 臼齿形态允许作有限的摄食推断；没有保存食物。
ecology.habitatZh: 颌骨来自 Griman Creek 沉积层；尚未确定其习惯性生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颌骨没有保存移动信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 仅凭这件下颌无法测量全身体型。
ecology.guildZh: 牙齿仅支持有限的摄食推断；更广泛的生态角色仍未确定。

traits: Fragment of the right lower jaw (dentary)
Teeth compared with monotreme and tribosphenic patterns
evidenceSummary: AM F66763 directly records a jaw fragment and three molars. Its 110–100 Ma interval is broad formation-level context; monotreme affinity and feeding are dental interpretations, not evidence for direct ancestry or a complete monotreme body plan.
evidenceSummaryZh: AM F66763 直接记录一块下颌碎片和三枚臼齿。110–100 Ma 是宽泛的地层背景；单孔类归属和摄食方式属于牙齿比较所得的解释，并非直系祖先或完整单孔类体制的证据。
traitsZh: 将牙齿与单孔类和三尖齿型进行比较。

overview: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b preserves an articulated skeleton, but matrix placements vary between basal Eutheria and outside Theria; neither result establishes ancestry.
overviewZh: *Eomaia scansoria* 的关节连接正模 CAGS 01-IG-1a,b 保存了头骨、牙齿和大部分头后骨骼，包括足与爪。原始分析曾将其置于基干真兽类；后来的联合矩阵也可能把 *Eomaia* 放到兽类之外。其位置取决于所取样的性状和分析方法，任何一个矩阵结果都不等于祖先关系。

ecology.diet: Dentition supports a small-prey or faunivorous interpretation; feeding was not observed.
ecology.habitat: The known occurrence is in the Yixian Formation; habitual microhabitat is not established by the lake deposits alone.
ecology.locomotion: Scansoriality is inferred from limb and foot proportions, not observed climbing.
ecology.bodySize: A small mammal represented by one articulated skeleton; population variation is unknown.
ecology.guild: A small scansorial faunivore is an anatomical inference, not an observed guild.
ecology.dietZh: 齿列支持其可能捕食小型猎物或以动物为食的解释；没有观察到摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 已知化石产自义县组；仅凭湖相沉积不能确定其惯常微栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 根据四肢和足部比例推断其具有攀援适应，而非直接观察到攀爬行为。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 一件关节相连骨架代表的小型哺乳动物；种群内的体型变异未知。
ecology.guildZh: 将其描述为小型、善于攀爬的食动物，是基于解剖结构的推断，并非观察到的生态功能类群。

traits: Dentition, feet and claws are available for comparison
Therian placement changes across sampled phylogenetic matrices
evidenceSummary: The single holotype supports anatomical study, while later matrices may place Eomaia outside Theria; 125.8–124.1 Ma is Yixian context, not direct specimen dating.

readerLimitations.en: The 125.8–124.1 Ma interval is the Yixian sample context, not a direct date on the holotype or a universal therian first appearance. Small-prey feeding and scansorial movement are anatomical interpretations; this single skeleton cannot establish population variation or habitual microhabitat.
readerLimitations.zh: 125.8–124.1 Ma 是义县组样本背景，不是正模的直接测年，也不是兽类的全球首现时间。小型猎物食性与攀援能力是依据牙齿和四肢作出的解释；单件骨架不能说明种群差异或惯常微栖地。

evidenceSummaryZh: 唯一一件关节相连的正模支持对解剖结构的详细描述，也支持原始的基干真兽类检验。后来的综合分析可能将 *Eomaia* 移出兽类；125.8–124.1 Ma 是所取样的义县组背景，并非兽类普遍的首次出现时间，也不是该标本的直接定年。
traitsZh: 关节相连的头骨和后颅骨。
齿列、足部和爪可供比较。
在不同取样的系统发育特征矩阵中，其兽类位置有所变化。

overview: Holotype ROM 55351A preserves elongated wings, five hand claws and a relatively small cochlea; matrix placement, flight and echolocation remain interpretations.
overviewZh: ROM 55351A 保存加长翼、手部五指上的爪和相对较小的耳蜗；飞行、回声定位及系统位置均为比较或分析结果，52.5–50.3 Ma 仅是地点背景。

ecology.diet: Insect-eating is inferred from the teeth; prey is not preserved.
ecology.habitat: The fossil comes from Green River lake deposits; a roosting site is not known.
ecology.locomotion: Wing anatomy supports powered flight, but performance is not directly observed.
ecology.bodySize: A small bat represented by a nearly complete skeleton; no broader size range is established here.
ecology.guild: An aerial insect-eater is inferred; specialized echolocation remains unresolved.
ecology.dietZh: 根据牙齿推断其食虫；化石未保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Green River 湖相沉积；其栖息的洞所未知。
ecology.locomotionZh: 翼部解剖结构支持其具备主动飞行能力，但未直接观察飞行表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 由近乎完整骨架代表的一种小型蝙蝠；这里没有确定更广的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 研究推断其为在空中捕食昆虫的动物；是否具有专门化回声定位能力仍未确定。

traits: Claws on all five digits of the hand
Relatively small cochlea compared with the sampled echolocating bats
evidenceSummary: ROM 55351A documents wing and cochlear anatomy; flight, diet and echolocation are inferred, and 52.5–50.3 Ma is locality context, not a global bat origin.
evidenceSummaryZh: ROM 55351A 记录翼和耳蜗结构；飞行、食性和回声定位属推断，52.5–50.3 Ma 是地点背景，不代表蝙蝠全球起源。
traitsZh: 与所取样的回声定位蝙蝠相比，耳蜗相对较小。

geography: Lower bone bed, phosphate bed IIa
overview: The *Eritherium azzouzorum* hypodigm includes holotype skull MNHN PM69 and 14 referred specimens from Sidi Chennane. Their skull and teeth supply characters for a comparative matrix testing the position of this early proboscidean. The matrix result is an analysis of sampled characters, not a direct-ancestry claim.
overviewZh: *Eritherium azzouzorum* 的材料来自 Sidi Chennane，包括正模头骨 MNHN PM69 和 14 件归入标本。研究将其头骨和牙齿特征放入比较性状矩阵，用于检验这类早期长鼻类的位置。矩阵结果来自对取样性状的分析，并非化石直接给出的祖先关系。

ecology.diet: Dental comparisons support a limited functional interpretation of feeding; diet is not directly observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from an Early Thanetian phosphate basin. This depositional setting does not establish the animal’s usual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Cranial and dental fossils do not establish locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: Dental allometry gives an estimated mass of 3–8 kg; this is a calculation, not a direct measurement.
ecology.guild: No feeding guild is directly observed; broad comparisons with ungulates remain interpretive.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿比较支持对其摄食功能作有限解释；食性并非直接观察所得。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自早塞兰特期的磷酸盐沉积盆地。这一沉积环境不能确定该动物通常生活的栖息地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 头骨和牙齿化石不能确定其运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 牙齿异速生长关系给出的体重估计为 3–8 kg；这是计算结果，并非直接测量值。
ecology.guildZh: 没有直接观察到其摄食功能类群；与有蹄类的大范围比较仍属解释。

traits: The holotype preserves the rostrum and upper teeth
Fourteen referred specimens add upper and lower teeth and cranial material
A character-matrix analysis proposes a stem-proboscidean position
evidenceSummary: The locality, 15-specimen hypodigm and skull–tooth anatomy are directly described. Stem placement, the 3–8 kg mass estimate and ecological readings depend on comparisons or analysis; the fossil is not identified as a direct ancestor.
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究直接描述了地点、十五件标本组合和头骨—牙齿形态。干群长鼻类位置、3–8 kg 体重估算与生态解释依赖比较或分析；这些化石没有被确定为后续长鼻类的直系祖先。

title.zh: MNHN PM69 与十五件标本组合

text.en: The *Eritherium azzouzorum* hypodigm includes holotype skull MNHN PM69 and 14 referred specimens from Sidi Chennane. Their skull and teeth supply characters for a comparative matrix testing the position of this early proboscidean. The matrix result is an analysis of sampled characters, not a direct-ancestry claim.
text.zh: *Eritherium azzouzorum* 的材料来自 Sidi Chennane，包括正模头骨 MNHN PM69 和 14 件归入标本。研究将其头骨和牙齿特征放入比较性状矩阵，用于检验这类早期长鼻类的位置。矩阵结果来自对取样性状的分析，并非化石直接给出的祖先关系。

title.en: The sample extends beyond the holotype
title.zh: 正模之外的十四件归入标本

text.en: Holotype skull MNHN PM69 preserves the rostrum and upper teeth. Fourteen referred specimens add upper and lower teeth and other cranial material, making this a 15-specimen hypodigm rather than a complete skeleton.
text.zh: 正模头骨 MNHN PM69 保存了吻部和上颌牙齿。另有十四件归入标本补充上、下颌牙齿和其他颅骨材料，因此证据来自十五件标本，而非一具完整骨架。

title.en: Dental allometry estimates mass; it does not weigh it
title.zh: 3–8 kg 是牙齿异速生长估值

text.en: Dental comparisons support a limited functional reading of feeding, while dental allometry estimates a mass of 3–8 kg. The value is calculated rather than directly measured, and the material does not identify a specific meal.
text.zh: 牙齿比较支持对取食功能作有限解释；牙齿异速生长关系推算体重约为 3–8 kg。该体重是计算估值，并非直接称量所得；现有材料也没有指明某一具体餐食。

title.en: Paleocene emergence of elephant relatives and the rapid radiation of African ungulates
title.zh: Paleocene emergence of elephant relatives and the rapid radiation of African ungulates

scope.en: Gheerbrant et al. (2009), pp. 10717?10721, Figures 1?3: MNHN PM69 and the referred hypodigm, locality and age, dental anatomy, the 3?8 kg allometric estimate and matrix placement.

readerLimitations.en: The sample comes from the lower bone bed of phosphate bed IIa at Sidi Chennane, Morocco, in the Early Thanetian. This depositional setting does not establish habitual habitat; cranial and dental material does not resolve locomotion or a feeding guild.
readerLimitations.zh: 样本来自摩洛哥 Sidi Chennane 的磷酸盐 IIa 层下部骨床，年代为早赞尼特期。这一沉积环境不能证明惯常栖息地；颅骨和牙齿材料也不能确定运动方式或取食类群。

traitsZh: 正模保存了吻部和上颌牙齿。
另有十四件归入标本，补充了上下颌牙齿和颅骨材料。
特征矩阵分析提出其可能位于干长鼻类。

overview: The holotype of *Mimolagus aurorae* is a right upper third molar (M3), IVPP V20115, from the Middle Eocene lower Irdin Manha Formation. Other teeth and tarsals are referred to the sample. These remains support comparative study of mimotonid anatomy and relationships, not a complete-body account.

ecology.diet: Herbivory inferred from dental morphology; direct food evidence absent
ecology.habitat: Lower Irdin Manha depositional setting; habitual microhabitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Locomotor capability inferred from tarsal comparisons
ecology.bodySize: About 4.5 kg estimated from comparative regressions; not directly weighed
ecology.guild: Large herbivorous duplicidentate inferred from ecomorphology

traits: Holotype right upper third molar IVPP V20115
Dental and tarsal characters scored in mimotonid comparisons
evidenceSummary: The named teeth and tarsals preserve anatomy and document an Erlian Basin occurrence. The estimated mass, inferred herbivory and locomotion, and proposed relationship to lagomorphs come from comparisons; they do not make *Mimolagus* a direct ancestor.

title.en: Right M3 IVPP V20115 and referred tarsals
title.zh: 右上第三臼齿正模与归入跗骨

text.en: The holotype of *Mimolagus aurorae* is a right upper third molar (M3), IVPP V20115, from the Middle Eocene lower Irdin Manha Formation. Other teeth and tarsals are referred to the sample. These remains support comparative study of mimotonid anatomy and relationships, not a complete-body account.
text.zh: *Mimolagus aurorae* 的正模是右上颌第三臼齿 M3，编号 IVPP V20115，来自中始新世下伊尔丁曼哈组；另有牙齿和跗骨被归入该样本。研究者用这些材料比较拟兔科动物的解剖特征和亲缘关系，并非复原一具完整骨架。

title.en: Teeth and ankle bones in comparative analyses
title.zh: 牙齿与踝骨进入比较分析

text.en: The holotype is right upper third molar IVPP V20115. Other teeth and tarsals are referred to the species. Dental and tarsal characters were included in comparative analyses of *Mimolagus*.
text.zh: 正模为右上颌第三臼齿 IVPP V20115。另有归入的牙齿和跗骨材料。研究将牙齿与跗骨性状纳入 *Mimolagus* 的比较分析。

title.en: Diet, movement and mass are comparative inferences
title.zh: 食性、运动与体重来自比较推断

text.en: Herbivory is inferred from dental form, with no direct food remains assigned. Tarsal comparisons inform locomotor interpretation; comparative regressions estimate a mass of about 4.5 kg rather than measure it. The lower Irdin Manha depositional setting does not resolve habitual microhabitat, and the proposed large herbivorous duplicidentate guild is an ecomorphological inference.
text.zh: 植食性来自牙齿形态推断，没有直接归入的食物遗骸。跗骨比较用于讨论运动方式；比较回归估计体重约为 4.5 kg，并非直接称量。下伊尔丁曼哈组的沉积背景不能确定惯常微栖地；“大型植食性双门齿类”的生态功能群判断也来自生态形态学推断。

title.zh: 具名材料与比较关系的边界

text.en: The named teeth and tarsals preserve anatomy and document an Erlian Basin occurrence. The estimated mass, inferred herbivory and locomotion, and proposed relationship to lagomorphs come from comparisons; they do not make *Mimolagus* a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 具名牙齿和跗骨记录了解剖特征及二连盆地的出现地点。体重估计、植食与运动解释，以及与兔形类的亲缘假说都来自比较；这些材料不能证明 *Mimolagus* 是直接祖先。

title.en: A large mimotonid from the Middle Eocene of China sheds light on the evolution of lagomorphs and their kin
title.zh: A large mimotonid from the Middle Eocene of China sheds light on the evolution of lagomorphs and their kin

scope.en: The description covers IVPP V20115 and referred teeth and tarsals; body mass and ecological role are comparative inferences.
scope.zh: 研究描述 IVPP V20115 及归入的牙齿和跗骨；体重与生态角色是比较推断。
